target.title: fix(agents): keep read warning args previews UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`read` tool validation warnings preview raw string args when neither `path` nor `file_path` is present. That preview was sliced on UTF-16 code-unit boundaries before console sanitization, so an emoji or other supplementary-plane character at the boundary could leave a lone surrogate in warning metadata.

## Why This Change Was Made

The final implementation switches the raw preview cut to `truncateUtf16Safe` before `sanitizeForConsole` runs, preserving the existing preview budget while avoiding malformed UTF-16 at the boundary. The regression test places an emoji exactly across the raw preview cutoff and asserts the warning metadata stays well-formed.

## User Impact

Read-tool validation warnings and console diagnostics no longer carry malformed UTF-16 when malformed args contain astral characters near the preview cap. A split pair is omitted instead of being surfaced as a lone surrogate.

## Evidence

- Exact reviewed head: `1b0b3f45007eec9088b649edb310f33e2b040c83`
- `git diff --check`: pass
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts`: pass (122 tests)
- Regression coverage verifies the surrogate-boundary warning preview path and keeps the existing ASCII truncation coverage green

Known proof gap: remote Testbox/Crabbox validation was unavailable in this environment because the local Crabbox binary failed basic sanity checks, so validation used the repo's narrow local fallback after installing dependencies in the isolated worktree. No remote proof claim is made.
